$comment: Registry of MCP servers published by the Palo Alto LiteLLM MCP gateway. 'remote' is the server name on the proxy (URL = <base>/<remote>/mcp). 'local' is the name registered in Claude Code / Cursor. Override the base URL with LITELLM_MCP_BASE_URL or `litellm_mcp.py config --base-url`.

confluence.summary: Search and read Confluence pages, children, comments

jira.summary: JQL search, issue details, projects, fields, attachments

gitlab.summary: Repos, files, issues, merge requests, CI pipelines

cortex_bot.summary: Full Cortex XSIAM/XSOAR/XDR incl. destructive IR actions

cortex_mcp.summary: Read-only Cortex XDR: cases, issues, assets, vulns

gcp_bq.summary: BigQuery datasets, tables, dry-run cost, SQL

figma_desktop.summary: Design context from the local Figma desktop app

secure_fetch.summary: Sanitized fetch of public or internal (VPN) URLs

gateway.summary: Aggregated endpoint: every server behind one entry (tool names match .ai/docs/mcp_gw.md)
